descriptions.punct-model: Punctuation model name (None to disable punctuation)
descriptions.lookahead: Lookahead size in milliseconds (0, 80, 480, 1040 for multi model)
descriptions.decoder: ASR decoder type to use ("rnnt" or "ctc")
descriptions.device: Audio device ID (number for microphone, 'remote' for remote stream, 'browser' for WebSocket audio, will prompt if not provided)
descriptions.chunk-size: Chunk size in milliseconds (auto-calculated if not provided)
descriptions.show-raw: Show both raw and punctuated text
descriptions.eou-threshold: Threshold for end-of-utterance detection (0.0-1.0, higher = less sensitive)
descriptions.eou-min-words: Minimum words required before considering text-based EOU
descriptions.eou-confirmation-needed: Number of consecutive positive detections needed for text-based EOU
descriptions.vad-model: VAD model to use: 'nvidia' for NeMo VAD or 'silero' for Silero VAD
descriptions.vad-silence-threshold: Number of consecutive low-activity frames needed for VAD-based EOU detection
descriptions.vad-speech-threshold: VAD probability threshold for speech detection (0.0-1.0). The probability above which a frame is considered speech
descriptions.vad-activity-threshold: Minimum frame activity ratio for speech detection (0.0-1.0). The proportion of frames in the analysis window that must be above the speech threshold to consider it as speech
descriptions.vad-speech-proportion-threshold: Speech proportion threshold for EOU detection (0.0-1.0, lower = more sensitive). When this is exceeded within the analysis window, an EOU is triggered.
descriptions.vad-analysis-window: Analysis window in seconds for speech proportion calculation
descriptions.vad-consecutive-silence-threshold: Consecutive silence duration in seconds needed for immediate EOU detection
descriptions.vad-min-frames-for-eou: Minimum frames needed before considering EOU (in seconds)
descriptions.vad-recent-speech-lookback-seconds: How far back to look for recent speech activity (in seconds)
descriptions.vad-recent-speech-threshold: Minimum speech proportion to consider recent activity
descriptions.websocket-host: WebSocket server host (enables WebSocket output when specified)
descriptions.log-level: Logging level: 'debug', 'info', 'warning', 'error', 'critical' (debug shows EOU info, info is quiet mode, verbose shows all details)
descriptions.log-file: Optional log file path (None for console only)
descriptions.log-max-size: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation
descriptions.log-backup-count: Number of backup log files to keep
descriptions.enable-whisper-buffer: Enable full utterance analysis with Whisper model after streaming EOU detection
descriptions.whisper-model: Whisper model name for full utterance analysis (e.g., 'distil-whisper/distil-small.en')
descriptions.whisper-buffer-duration: Duration in seconds of audio buffer for Whisper analysis (default: 45)
descriptions.whisper-trust-over-streaming: If true, only output utterances if Whisper confirms text exists
